english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the main room where people relax and socialise at home.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the room where residents or guests relax and spend time.
Use this for the reception or living room in a home where guests are received and entertained.

examples.english: We’re watching the match in the living room tonight, so there’s no need to go to the bedroom.
examples.traditional: 我哋今晚喺客廳睇波，唔使入房。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 hai2 haak3 teng1 tai2 bo1 m4 sai2 jap6 fong4

examples.english: We watched TV in the sitting room.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zo6 hai2 haak3 teng1 tai2 din6 si6

examples.english: Our relatives came over, and we chatted in the salon.
examples.traditional: 親戚嚟咗，我哋喺客廳傾偈。
examples.jyutping: can1 cik1 lai4 zo2 ngo5 dei6 hai2 haak3 teng1 king1 gai2
